# Windows Game Explorer v2.8.0

> Icon overhaul, physical Games folder, per-user registration, Defender mitigation, and documentation audit.

|---|---|

---

## Overview

**Windows Game Explorer v2.8.0** overhauls the icon system, introduces a physical Games folder for game shortcuts, makes registration fully per-user (no admin required), and adds Windows Defender false-positive mitigation documentation and tooling.

### Icon Overhaul
- App icon now uses an on-disk `.ico` file (`game-explorer.ico`) instead of being embedded in the DLL, fixing the issue where the DLL overrode Explorer's process icon.
- Windows 10 icon renamed to `game-explorer-icon-alt.ico` as an alternate optional icon.
- `IExtractIconW` re-implemented using the documented per-item icon mechanism.
- `DefaultIcon` and `Icon` registry values cleaned up to prevent Task Manager misattribution.

### Physical Games Folder
- Created `%USERPROFILE%\Games` as a physical backing folder with `Desktop.ini` junction point.
- `.lnk` shortcuts created during scan for each detected game.
- Shortcuts updated when metadata changes in the Library Manager.
- Shortcuts removed when games are removed.
- `.lnk` scanning added to `ScanAllInstalledGames`.

### Per-User Registration
- Registration no longer requires Administrator rights (HKCU-only).
- Service installed via user-level scheduled task (no LocalSystem, no UAC).
- Service does not auto-restart on failure (`SC_ACTION_NONE`).
- Studio `--register`/`--unregister` work without elevation.

### Windows Defender Mitigation
- SCM strings verified (proper display name + description).
- Code signing script (`generate-cert.ps1`) for self-signed dev certs.
- NSIS installer imports public cert into TrustedPublisher.
- CI workflow enhanced with packaging + release steps.
- Winget manifest created and validated.
- Troubleshooting docs updated with Defender false-positive info.

### Documentation Audit
- All `%USERPROFILE%\Game Explorer` → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Game Explorer` references updated.
- TODO.md updated with future work (GUI framework rewrite, cross-platform).
- CHANGELOG, ROADMAP, and other docs updated.

### Bug Fixes
- Service auto-restart on kill fixed.
- Legacy command bar documented as known issue.
- IndieGala platform bloc completed.

---

## Installation

Download `windows-game-explorer-v2.8.0-setup.exe` from the release assets and run it. The installer supports both per-user (no admin) and all-users installation.

For portable use, extract `windows-game-explorer-v2.8.0-win64.zip` and run `game-explorer.bat register`.
